contactInfo.name: Diego Fernando Rayo Zamora
contactInfo.label: Software Developer | TypeScript, React, and Node.js

summary.short: I'm Diego, a Systems and Computing Engineer from Universidad del Quindío, Colombia, with 8 years of experience developing web applications. I specialize in front-end development with JavaScript/TypeScript and React/Next.js, and also have experience working with Node.js, ORMs, and SQL/NoSQL databases. I’ve worked with startups, digital agencies, and as a freelancer. I have a B1 level of English. I'm interested in remote Front-end Developer roles to continue strengthening my experience in this area while further adopting AI in my workflow to improve productivity and maintain a high standard of work.
summary.full:
I'm Diego, a Systems and Computing Engineer from Universidad del Quindío, Colombia.
			I have 8 years of experience as a Software Developer, collaborating on the design, implementation, and maintenance of web applications.
			Most of my experience has been on the front-end side, primarily working with JavaScript/TypeScript and React/Next.js.
			I also have the ability to work on the back-end, contributing to the development and maintenance of Node.js-based applications using various ORMs and both SQL and NoSQL database engines.
			I have worked mainly for start-ups, as well as freelance and for digital agencies.
			I am fluent in English at a B1 level.
			I'm interested in remote Front-end Developer roles. I want to continue strengthening my knowledge and experience in this area, while deepening my understanding of AI adoption in my workflow through automations, agents, and skills that help me be more productive and maintain a high standard of work.

Maintained the legacy Festa web application for several months. This version had a monolithic architecture built with PHP and jQuery.
